title: Viewport-height clamp detaches virtualized tail follow
outcome: A native upward scrollTop delta with unchanged scrollHeight is treated as user movement, but clientHeight changes can produce the same clamp while the reader remains pinned. Composer collapse, prompt-chip removal, or a taller window can therefore hard-detach bottom authority mid-stream. Track previous clientHeight or maxScrollTop geometry and require stable geometry before classifying a negative delta as reader input; add handler-level coverage for pinned viewport growth.
acceptance: Viewport-height-only clamps keep tail-follow attached; genuine stable-geometry upward input detaches; composer collapse and window-height regressions are covered; TypeScript and Vitest pass.
